about_the_game:
Illuminate classics with a brush, create miracles with AI!

Welcome to "AI PAINTER: Painting Simulator," a creative world that cleverly combines the joy of painting with card strategy! Here, you'll transform into an imaginative painter, recreating masterpieces through simple doodles with AI magic, and collecting artistic cards with unique styles.

【How to Start AI Painting】

1. Upon entering the drawing interface, the game automatically starts the local AI service

2. Initially, you'll see dynamic colored stripes - this is the normal display during AI model loading

3. During loading, a green progress bar appears at the bottom of the stripes, showing real-time loading progress

4. When progress reaches 100%, the system automatically switches to AI painting mode

5. Now you can start creating! Every stroke will be transformed into beautiful art by AI in real-time

【Core Gameplay】

Magical Brush, AI Wonders:

Draw your creative sketches on the right canvas, and AI will display the processed artwork on the left in real-time. Response speed varies from real-time to several seconds depending on your computer configuration.

Master Styles at Your Fingertips:

You'll have the opportunity to access various cards imbued with classic art souls. Imagine obtaining a Van Gogh "Sunflowers" card - every stroke seems infused with the great painter's passion and colors, ultimately generating a sunflower painting filled with Van Gogh's essence.

Card Collection, Unlimited Possibilities:

By completing levels and challenges, you'll obtain various art cards. Each card represents a unique artistic style or theme, such as Van Gogh's passionate expression or Monet's interplay of light and shadow. Card backs contain key "prompt words" that drive AI image generation.

Level Challenges, Progressive Improvement:

The game adopts a simple and fun level mode. Each level provides specific cards. Your task is to paint according to the artistic style or theme on the cards, with AI scoring based on how well your work matches the target style.

【Game Features】

• Simple to Learn: No professional painting skills required - simple doodles let you experience AI artistic creation

• Rich Artistic Styles: Covering Van Gogh's passion, Monet's beauty, and other classic masters' styles

• Unique Card Collection System: Each card is a key to creation

• Relaxing Casual Gameplay: Enjoy painting and exploration through simple level challenges and card collection

• AI-Driven Unlimited Creativity: Let AI be your artistic partner, transforming imagination into unique artworks

Join "AI PAINTER: Painting Simulator," pick up your brush, collect your art cards, and embark on an artistic journey full of creativity and surprises!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 4060
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 5090 32g
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
